name: Latin American and Iberian Studies - BA
narrative:
MAJOR REGULATIONS
PREREQUISITES Check the General Catalog for the prerequisites to all listed courses.
P/NP GRADING OPTION Not allowed for any major course (Prep or UD major).
SUBSTITUTIONS In the major requirements permissible only by petition to the program director and dean.
G.P.A. REQUIREMENTS At least 2.0 overall UC average in all upper-division major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major.
DOUBLE MAJORS With the approval of each department chairperson or program director, up to a total of 8 units may be applied simultaneously to both UD majors.
